subject: EdgePay dedicated fleet smoothing / capacity adjustment request
messages:
From: Janelle Ramos <janelle.ramos@edgepay.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: EdgePay Platform Team <it@edgepay.com>, Tom Delgado <tom.delgado@edgepay.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request to smooth dedicated fleet ahead of renewal

Hi Karthik —

Hope you’re well. We’re approaching our renewal and looking to rebalance the dedicated fleet mix to better match real usage. Q3 telemetry shows heavy burstiness on the low-latency chat lanes and underutilization on long-context rerank jobs.

Can Redwood help with a short-term tranche add and a sizing pass so we don’t overcommit at renewal? High-level asks:
- Temporary +8 A100-equivalent GPUs for the next 6 weeks (to cover predictable Black Friday peaks)
- Rightsize the baseline after analyzing actual utilization (we’d prefer a conservative baseline vs. a big upfront commit)
- Visibility into how autoscaling and KV prefix caching would affect our unit costs if we smooth instead of bursting

I’ve attached our Q3 usage export and a doc with current incident windows. Happy to jump on a call.

Thanks,
Janelle Ramos
VP Product Operations
EdgePay

Attachment: EdgePay_Q3_usage_by_model.csv
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Janelle Ramos <janelle.ramos@edgepay.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to smooth dedicated fleet ahead of renewal

Janelle —

Thanks for the dataset, that’s exactly what we need to do a rightsizing pass. Quick next steps from our side:
1) Marcus will run a utilization decomposition to recommend a tranche add and a conservative baseline.
2) Evelyn will run a cost-impact simulation for autoscale + KV prefix caching so we can show unit economics for smoothing vs. burst-only.
3) I’ll put together a mutual action plan (MAP) with timeline and rollback triggers.

Can you confirm: 1) whether the proposed +8 A100s can be delivered as a short-term tranche (6–8 weeks), and 2) whether your procurement team prefers a single PO for the tranche + baseline or separate POs?

If you’re free Friday I can do a 30m to walk through the Q3 highlights.

—Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: MAP_EdgePay_capacity_smoothing.xlsx
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to smooth dedicated fleet ahead of renewal — initial sizing notes

All —

I ran the utilization decomposition on the CSV Janelle shared. Key findings (short):
- Peak concurrency for low-latency chat increases 3.8x during regional peak windows; median utilization across the fleet is ~42%.
- Long-tail rerank/embedding workloads run at low concurrency but consume long sequences, which inflates token compute time but not GPU occupancy consistently.
- Current autoscale policy is aggressive on latency SLOs; we can reduce baseline by ~15% if we adopt prefix caching for chat and slightly increase max burst capacity.

Recommendation:
- Provision an 8x A100 short tranche for the 6-week peak horizon (matches their ask).
- After telemetry window (6 weeks) perform an after-action rightsizing: drop baseline by 10–18% based on observed prefix cache hitrate and steady-state concurrency.
- Configure autoscale floor at 60% of current baseline and set a 3-minute scale-up runway for burst lanes to preserve latency SLOs.

I’m attaching a one-page tranche proposal (proposed_tranche_add_A100_8x.pdf) and an internal runbook snippet with rollout and rollback triggers. If procurement wants a single PO, finance will need the tranche cost spelled out separately from the baseline commit.

-Marcus
Director, Serving Runtime Optimization
Attachment: proposed_tranche_add_A100_8x.pdf
From: Janelle Ramos <janelle.ramos@edgepay.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Delgado <tom.delgado@edgepay.com>, EdgePay Platform Team <it@edgepay.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 02 Nov 2026 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to smooth dedicated fleet ahead of renewal — next steps and procurement preference

Thanks — this looks good. Procurement confirmed they prefer two-line items (tranche as temporary add + a smaller baseline commit) so they can approve the tranche quickly without increasing long-term spend.

Let’s do the following:
- Lock the 8x A100 tranche starting Nov 9 for 6 weeks.
- Run prefix-caching config in staging next 72 hrs; redeploy to production on Nov 8 outside business hours.
- Post-peak rightsizing review meeting scheduled for Dec 28 to decide final baseline for renewal.

Can you send a short SOW/PO appendix for the tranche costs and the baseline commit split so we can route it through procurement? Also propose 30m on Nov 5 (your timezone) for implementation coordination.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Janelle

Janelle Ramos
VP Product Operations, EdgePay
